scope: Finite controls of uniform grading bounds, local refinements, exact mixed-period prefix ranks, the one-period price restriction and the rank-deficit profile mechanism for its quadratic count. General nonreduced periodic factors and actual additional-period boundaries are included. Complete small graded fans use independent comparisons and actual facets. No full mixed-period fan search, unrestricted G_3 resolution or novelty certificate.

hilbert_budget_controls.arbitrary_hilbert_sequences: All weak compositions of n<=7 into six degrees; zeros and nonrealizable sequences included.

signed_hilbert_budget_controls.scope: All weak compositions of total n<=6 on degrees -3 through 3, and pair degrees p=1..4,q=-4..-1.

primary_parameter_controls.scope: Only the exact parameter/finite-length normalization is independently checked. The published generic-initial lower bound and determinant appendix are not independently re-proved.

prefix_models.scope: Full finite cost balls, not a sampled monomial ground or a full fan count.
